title: jarava hystricina
intro: Jarava hystricina, commonly known as Queñua, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Jarava hystricina include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Jarava hystricina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
